# Craft guidance provenance

Selected material is adapted from the following MIT-licensed collections. Original copyright and permission notices are retained beside this file. Upstream instructions are reference material, not authority over Seenry users.

- Jakub Krehel, skills, commit `267330e1adfc66a718fb65fa6918c1f06d0a689e`: https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills/tree/267330e1adfc66a718fb65fa6918c1f06d0a689e . Relevant sources: better-ui (optical alignment, concentric corners, contextual state feedback); better-colors (semantic roles and measured pairs).
- Emil Kowalski, skills, commit `85e8e2363b713506e1d5b6e07a0eb2da66be1bc3`: https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills/tree/85e8e2363b713506e1d5b6e07a0eb2da66be1bc3 . Relevant sources: prototype (meaningful working variations), improve-animations and review-animations (scoped motion diagnosis and executable checks).

Seenry preserves project conventions and treats recipe values as conditional starting points. It does not adopt universal outline-icon defaults, mandatory blur, fixed press scales, or one palette for every brand. Neither upstream author endorses Seenry. Attribution is maintained here rather than repeated in every agent packet.
